conversion.title: Convert imported account
conversion.description: Turn a Skrooge debt account into a managed liability.
conversion.loadError: Could not load accounts. Try again.
conversion.empty: No eligible imported debt accounts. Accounts must have a negative balance and no linked assets.
conversion.name: Liability name
conversion.termsHint: Review the agreed principal and the total already borrowed against your loan statement. The agreed principal includes funds still to be drawn; the total already borrowed includes any principal you have repaid.
conversion.effect_one: The account will be closed and its debt moved here. Its {{count}} imported transaction remains available in Linked payments. New payments are managed here from today. Cash flow and net worth stay unchanged.
conversion.effect_other: The account will be closed and its debt moved here. Its {{count}} imported transactions remain available in Linked payments. New payments are managed here from today. Cash flow and net worth stay unchanged.
conversion.retryHint: The result is not yet confirmed. Retry safely with the same details.
conversion.invalidDate: Choose a loan start date no later than today.
conversion.invalidEndDate: End date must follow the start date.
conversion.fundedMinimum: Total borrowed must cover the outstanding debt.
conversion.principalMinimum: Agreed principal must cover the total already borrowed.
conversion.importedHistory: Includes the original account history. Managed payments start on {{date}}.
conversion.archivedAccount: Converted to a managed liability. This account is kept for its history; record new payments in Liabilities.
conversion.mortgagePreset: Confirmed mortgage terms are prefilled. Review the property, dates and amounts before continuing; the first principal repayment date was inferred from the contract maturity.
conversion.propertyHint: Select the converted property. If it is not listed, convert the imported asset in Real Estate first. Linking allocates this mortgage to the property without creating a payment.
conversion.propertyError: Properties could not be loaded. Close and reopen the wizard to retry.
conversion.propertyRequired: Select the property financed by this mortgage.
conversion.feesHint: Only enter fees not already included in the payments you will link. Linked fees are counted automatically.

payments.incomplete: Choose a component for every selected payment and split, or deselect the payment.

payments.effect: Selected payments will be associated in the same conversion. They will not be recreated or deducted from the outstanding balance again.
